description: Get a market-wide event calendar over a date range: earnings, IPOs, dividends, splits, economic releases, market holidays, or live exchange open/closed status. Unlike get_calendar (per-symbol), this spans the whole market.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = all fields

kind.description: Which market-wide calendar to fetch: earnings | ipo | dividend | split | economic | market-holiday | market-status

name: get_market_calendar
title: Market-Wide Event Calendar
